name: What is the step-by-step process of installing a tile backsplash?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process of installing a tile backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation begins with inspecting and repairing the drywall surface so it is plumb and smooth. Next, the installer marks level reference lines and does dry layout cuts around outlets and window frames. Thin-set mortar or mastic is troweled onto the wall, and tiles are set in place using spacers. After the adhesive sets overnight, the crew fills the joints with grout, cleans away excess haze, and applies color-matched silicone caulk along the countertop-to-wall expansion joint.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes wall prep, layout layout planning, setting tiles in mortar, curing, applying grout, cleaning haze, and caulking all perimeter seams.
